hooks.command: bash -c 'CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACM -- "*.java" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$CHANGED" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! command -v semgrep &>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; RESULT=$(semgrep --config=auto --severity=ERROR --severity=WARNING --exclude="*/bin/*" --exclude="*/build/*" --json --quiet $CHANGED 2>/dev/null || true); COUNT=$(echo "$RESULT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; data=json.load(sys.stdin); print(len(data.get(\"results\",[])))"); if [ "$COUNT" != "0" ] && [ "$COUNT" != "" ]; then echo "[security-review] Found $COUNT issue(s) in changed Java files. Run /code-rw for full audit."; fi'
